item.tib: grub thob rnam gsum gyi gsol 'debs
item.coloph: zhes grub thob rnam gsum gyi gsol 'debs 'di ni nges pa don gyi bshes gnyen chen po grub dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan rin po che'i thugs bzhed ltar du gang gi dngos slob dge legs lhun grub rgya mtshos bsnyen sgrub kyi thun mtshams su bris pa dge legs 'phel//
